mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_message (conversation_id, user_id, role, content, status, trace_id, finish_reason, error_message) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{traceId}, #{finishReason}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_message SET trace_id = #{traceId} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'GENERATING'

UPDATE sa_message SET content = #{content}, status = 'COMPLETED', trace_id = #{traceId}, finish_reason = #{finishReason}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'GENERATING'

UPDATE sa_message SET content = #{content}, status = 'FAILED', trace_id = COALESCE(#{traceId}, trace_id), finish_reason = 'error', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'GENERATING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, status, trace_id, finish_reason, error_message, create_time FROM sa_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND trace_id = #{traceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, status, trace_id, finish_reason, error_message, create_time FROM sa_message WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
